effect: The commissioning run produced methane, but the mixed gas still needs processing before it can serve as rocket fuel.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the reactor controls was most worthwhile: the explanation that the reaction needs both startup heat and cooling made the assembly informative.

leastWorthwhile.text: Mounting the retort was the least engaging moment; the result gave no detail beyond the new item name.

surprise.text: The test cylinder contained water vapour and unreacted gases alongside methane, so producing the molecule is not the same as preparing rocket fuel.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, although the carbon dioxide coupling gave no detail about the connection.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the mixed gas becomes usable fuel and how the frozen discovery reaches Earth, though the chapter's only-option sequence offered little decision-making.
